title: Financial Services Administrator
description:
My client is a Chartered Independent Financial Advisory firm based in Chester, who have a passion for financial planning and provide expert, impartial financial advice for individuals, families and businesses. Focusing on personal goals, investment opportunities, planning and saving for retirement and improving tax efficiency.

We are urgently seeking an experienced Personal Financial Administrator to join an existing team supporting 9 Financial Advisers.

Specifically you'll be responsible for:
- New business processing (investments, pensions, mortgages & life).
- Valuations.
- Client servicing, e.g., switches, rebalance, withdrawals etc.
- Providing quotes using exchange and platforms.
- Dealing with policy enquiries.
- Telephone and reception duties as required.
- General Admin support including handling post and typing.

The ideal candidate for this role will have experience working within Financial Services Administration, this could be from a Bank, Insurance Company, Mortgage Brokers or Pensions firm, but ideally from a Financial Advisory firm. You will be organised & methodical, have excellent attention to detail, be organised and able to prioritise and meet deadlines and have effective communication skills both written and verbal. If you have worked with Intelliflow, Selectapension, Trigold, Assureweb previously, then this would be to your advantage, as well as any experience with Platforms such as Abrdn, Aviva and Aegon.

title: HR Administrator
description:
As an HR Administrator in the industrial and manufacturing sector based in Chester, you'll focus on supporting the day-to-day operations of the Human Resources department. From handling key administrative tasks to ensuring processes run smoothly, your role will help keep the team organised and effective.

Client Details

This company operates within the industrial and manufacturing sector and is based in Chester.

Description
- Provide comprehensive HR administrative support, including the preparation of employment contracts, contractual amendments, absence management documentation, and employee correspondence.
- Assist with onboarding and offboarding activities, ensuring all documentation, compliance checks, and HR system updates are completed accurately and in a timely manner.
- Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases, ensuring data integrity, confidentiality, and compliance with internal audit requirements.
- Prepare, collate, and submit monthly payroll information, including details of starters, leavers, salary amendments, absence records, and other employee changes.
- Act as a key point of contact for the outsourced payroll provider, resolving queries and ensuring payroll data is submitted accurately and within agreed deadlines.
- Review payroll reports and support the investigation and resolution of any discrepancies prior to payroll processing.
- Administer employee benefits and respond to day-to-day HR and payroll-related queries.
- Support recruitment and employee life cycle activities, including interview scheduling, offer administration, and pre-employment checks.
- Handle sensitive employee and payroll information with discretion, professionalism, and strict confidentiality.
- Identify and support opportunities to improve HR processes, systems, and administrative efficiencies across the function.

Profile

Essential Criteria
- Previous experience in an HR Administrator, HR Assistant, or similar people support role.
- Experience using HR systems (HRIS) to maintain employee records, update employee information, and process changes throughout the employee life cycle.
- Proven experience preparing, checking, and coordinating payroll information for monthly payroll processing.
- Experience working with an outsourced payroll provider or external payroll bureau, ensuring accurate and timely data submission.
- Excellent organisational skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Ability to effectively manage multiple deadlines, priorities, and routine HR and payroll activities.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build positive working relationships at all levels.
- Demonstrated ability to handle confidential and sensitive employee information with professionalism and discretion.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
- Capable of working independently while contributing effectively within a fast-paced HR team environment.

Desirable Criteria
- CIPD Level 3 qualification, or currently studying towards a CIPD qualification.
- Experience using HR systems such as Cascade, HiBob, or similar HR and people management platforms.
- Previous experience supporting employee benefits administration and benefits-related queries.
- Experience working within a growing, evolving, or transformation-focused organisation.
- Exposure to continuous improvement initiatives, including the enhancement of HR processes, systems, and ways of working.

Job Offer
- Competitive salary and overall rewards package.
- Excellent opportunities for professional development and long-term career progression within a growing organisation.
- Flexible working arrangements to support a positive work-life balance.
- Generous annual leave entitlement, in addition to public holidays.
- Employer-funded pension scheme with enhanced company contributions.
- A range of additional wellbeing and protection benefits, including life assurance, income protection, and critical illness cover.
- Private healthcare provision or a flexible benefits allowance.
- A collaborative, inclusive, and supportive working environment, where employees are encouraged to contribute, develop, and succeed.
- Access to a comprehensive benefits programme designed to support your financial, physical, and mental wellbeing.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Project Coordinator Operations & Compliance

We re looking for a proactive and practical Project Coordinator Operations & Compliance to support the running and ongoing development of waste and recycling sites.

Salary £35-40k plus mileage

Location: North West You may be based in Chester, Buckley, Mold, Wrexham and surrounding areas.

There will be regular travel between company sites

About the Role

Working closely with the General Manager and key department leads, you ll play a central role in coordinating logistics, improving operational efficiency, managing site projects, monitoring costs and supporting high standards of environmental, health and safety compliance.

This is a varied, hands-on position combining project coordination and planning with practical involvement in site operations. From coordinating container loading and material movements to overseeing machinery installations, facility improvements and safety actions, you ll help ensure our sites operate safely, efficiently and cost-effectively.

You may have been - Project Coordinator, Operations Coordinator, Operations Project Coordinator, Operations Manager, Project Manager, Site Coordinator, Site Operations Coordinator, Business Operations Coordinator, Operational Support Coordinator, Environmental Compliance Coordinator, Health & Safety Coordinator, EHS Coordinator, SHEQ Coordinator, HSEQ Coordinator

Key Responsibilities as a Project Coordinator:

Operations & Logistics
- Coordinate daily workflows, collections, deliveries and processing schedules across three sites.
- Work closely with warehouse, administration, engineering and compliance teams to maintain efficient material flow.

Project & Facilities Coordination
- Coordinate projects from planning through to completion, including site upgrades, machinery installations and new recycling processes.
- Monitor facility, maintenance and equipment costs, helping keep projects and site improvements within budget.

Compliance, Health & Safety
- Support the Compliance & H&S Manager in maintaining environmental, hazardous waste and workplace safety standards.
- Coordinate site inspections, risk assessments, fire drills and toolbox talks.
- Maintain accurate safety records, track incidents and near misses, and follow up on corrective actions.

Reporting & Cost Control
- Monitor key performance indicators, including tonnage processed and recovery rates.
- Reconcile contractor, maintenance, safety equipment and logistics invoices before management approval.
- Prepare weekly operational, safety and project updates for the General Manager.

About You:

You ll ideally have:
- At least 3 years experience in project coordination, operations or operational support within an industrial, recycling, waste management or logistics environment.
- Experience coordinating workflows, schedules, goods movements or activities across multiple sites.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, with confidence in reporting, data tracking and basic budget reconciliation.
- An understanding of workplace health and safety, environmental compliance and hazardous waste handling.
- Experience monitoring facility costs, maintenance expenditure or project budgets.
- A full, clean UK driving licence and willingness to travel regularly between our three sites.

Experience with inventory or operational management software would be an advantage.
